T: Anyone can be anything. Except hungry.
D: A rookie bunny cop teams up with a con artist fox to solve a missing animals case.
P: Serve dessert when Nick sells his little red paw pops.
S: Roasted carrot fries with smoked paprika and a garlic yoghurt dip
Carrots cut into fries, tossed in oil, smoked paprika and salt, roasted at 220C for 25 minutes until caramelised, with a garlic dip.
Fried yeast doughnut balls rolled in cinnamon sugar
Yeasted dough proved, rolled into small balls, fried at 175C until golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar while warm.
the blueberries Judy brings Nick from the family farm

Toasted brioche spread with honey-whipped ricotta, piled with jammy blistered blueberries and toasted almonds, Hopps family farm produce. Whip 250g ricotta with 2 tbsp honey and 1 tsp vanilla until smooth. Cook 250g blueberries with 1 tbsp sugar and a squeeze of lemon in a pan over high heat for 3 minutes until some burst. Toast 4 thick slices of brioche, halve them and spread with the ricotta. Spoon over the warm blueberries and scatter with 30g toasted flaked almonds.
M: Chicken thighs with saffron, ginger, green olives and preserved lemon
Chicken thighs browned and slow cooked 90 minutes with onion, preserved lemon, green olives, ginger and saffron, served over fluffy couscous.

Smoked fish and salmon poached in a creamy potato and leek chowder with dill and bacon crumbs, with crusty bread for the snowy district. Fry 100g diced bacon until crisp and set aside. Soften 1 sliced leek in 30g butter, add 500g diced potatoes and 800ml fish stock and simmer 12 minutes. Stir in 300ml cream, then add 250g smoked cod and 250g salmon in chunks and poach gently for 5 minutes. Season, stir in chopped dill and serve topped with the bacon, with crusty bread.
W: Strawberry, watermelon and lime frozen on sticks

Strawberries and watermelon blended with lime juice and sugar, poured into small ice block moulds with sticks and frozen overnight. Blend 250g strawberries with 500g watermelon, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Pour into ice block moulds, push in sticks and freeze overnight. Sell them at a good markup, or just hand them out.
K: Kiwifruit, cucumber, mint and lime over ice with soda water
Kiwifruit, cucumber and mint blended with lime and sugar, topped with soda water over ice.

s.note: Roasted carrot fries with smoked paprika and a garlic yoghurt dip
s.how: Cut 800g carrots into fries and toss with olive oil, smoked paprika and sea salt. Roast at 220C for 25 minutes until caramelised at the edges. Stir crushed garlic into Greek yoghurt for a dip. Fresh from the farm.

s.note: Fried yeast doughnut balls rolled in cinnamon sugar
s.how: Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 2 eggs, 50g butter and warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll into small balls and fry at 175C until golden. Roll in cinnamon sugar while warm. One for every doughnut-loving cheetah at the front desk.

m.note: Chicken thighs with saffron, ginger, green olives and preserved lemon
m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thighs, then soften a sliced onion with grated ginger and a pinch of saffron. Add 500ml water, chopped preserved lemon and green olives. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes until tender. Serve over fluffy couscous.

w.note: Strawberry, watermelon and lime frozen on sticks
w.how: Blend 250g strawberries with 500g watermelon, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp sugar until smooth. Pour into ice block moulds, push in sticks and freeze overnight. Sell them at a good markup, or just hand them out.

d.note: Kiwifruit, cucumber, mint and lime over ice with soda water
d.how: Blend 3 peeled kiwifruit with a Lebanese cucumber, a handful of mint, the juice of a lime and 2 tbsp sugar. Strain into a jug. Pour over ice and top with soda water. Green and misty like the rainforest district.
